title: Garibaldi Charters

services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: After a few less than ideal weather days, we’re back at it strong with the tuna fishing! Folks have been having a blast pulling in these strong fighting fish 30-40 miles offshore. Space is very limited on tuna trips, so get your seats

services.name: Whale Watching with Crabbing
services.desc: The California Grey Whales pass through our waters on their migration route from Baja California to Alaska. They love to feed and play just off the entrance to Tillamook Bay and around the many beautiful rock formations found on our unique stretch of ocean. Tours are usually in the afternoon, but time may be changed
